name: AI Order Insights for WooCommerce – Intelligent Customer Analysis & Upsell Recommendations
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
AI Order Insights for WooCommerce by VerseSofts transforms your standard WooCommerce orders into actionable business intelligence using advanced AI models like Google Gemini and OpenAI. Gain instant clarity on customer lifetime value, personalized upsell opportunities, and retention recommendations—all generated automatically the moment an order is placed.

By leveraging artificial intelligence, store owners can move beyond basic spreadsheets and understand the “why” behind every purchase. This plugin provides the professional data architecture needed to scale your personal customer service and maximize every transaction’s value without increasing your manual workload.

Key Features for Intelligent Growth

  • AI-Powered Order Analysis: Automatically analyze every incoming order using Google Gemini or OpenAI to identify hidden trends.
  • Customer Value Assessment: Precisely identify high-value repeat customers and categorize purchase patterns instantly.
  • Smart Upsell Recommendations: Generate specific, context-aware product suggestions based on the actual items in the current order.
  • Personalized Support Notes: Receive AI-generated warm messages tailored to the customer’s specific purchase for use in emails or packaging.
  • Loyalty Retention Strategy: Get smart discount code or freebie recommendations designed specifically to boost repeat purchase rates.
  • Manual On-Demand Trigger: Generate new insights for any existing historical order with a single click from the admin dashboard.
  • Dual AI Provider Support: Choose the provider that fits your needs best, with full support for both Google Gemini and OpenAI.
  • HPOS Certified: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage for maximum database efficiency.

How It Works

  1. Install & Configure: Enter your Gemini or OpenAI API key in the WooCommerce settings panel securely.
  2. Automatic Processing: When an order status transitions to “Processing”, the AI engine analyzes it immediately.
  3. Actionable Data: Review the structured insights directly within the “AI Order Insights” meta box on the WooCommerce order page.
  4. Execute Decisions: Use the generated suggestions to personalize your follow-up marketing or customer service workflows.

Privacy & Data Security

We take your data privacy seriously. Only the essential, non-sensitive order data (item names, quantities, and customer first name) is transmitted to your chosen AI provider. No credit card information, full addresses, or passwords are ever sent or stored outside your server.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “AI Order Insights for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > AI Order Insights to enter your API key.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org securely.
  2. Upload the entire unzipped versesofts-ai-order-insights folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > AI Order Insights.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid AI account?

Both Google Gemini and OpenAI offer generous free tiers. Gemini’s free tier is typically sufficient for most small to medium WooCommerce stores.

Is my customer data safe?

Yes. Only essential, non-sensitive data (items and first name) is sent to the AI provider. No financial details or full addresses are ever transmitted.

Can I trigger analysis manually?

Absolutely. You can click the “Generate Insights Now” button on any individual order page to analyze existing orders on-demand.

Where can I get support for this plugin?

We offer professional, dedicated support directly via email: contact@versesofts.com
